review.notes: Triage review of the 192-page report. Machine-scanned: all 192 pages via normalized page-text 4-gram containment against the OCR markdown (no page below 75% except reordered table/figure pages) plus unique-word coverage for the 47 lowest pages - all at 97-100%, so no mass prose droppage; an exhaustive footnote scan (page-bottom paragraphs, all 49 found) - every footnote body is dropped from the OCR while all 49 markers survive; global code-fence scan (one balanced pair, lines 369-374) and full heading scan (structure faithful, small-caps run-in styling preserved as caps). Line-read with rendered pages (110-300 dpi strips/crops, visually checked): all 34 pages carrying footnotes, and targeted crops on pp. 13, 33, 75, 123, 124, 177, 182. The PDF text layer proved unreliable in two ways and was never trusted blindly: it scrambled fn23's word order ("For Kaitiakitanga License consider example, the" for the printed "For example, consider the Kaitiakitanga License") and lowercases Table 1's superscript NEW marker (printed superscript small-cap "NEW", correctly kept uppercase in the OCR - no patch). Possible duplicated text layers flagged for this document: word-coverage found no duplicated or doubled content in the OCR, and every restored footnote body was verified against its rendered strip. Print's own misspellings are preserved (attentuate p.75 restored after OCR auto-corrected it; Libraray p.182; 'partially covering our of interest' p.29; fn11 'lucky to have Ligurian native speaker'; 'here are the list of directions' p.177). Figure-internal label text ("Perason", "Kendal" in Figure 24, axis words) lives inside embedded figure images or printed figures, not OCR prose defects.
